---
title: "Case 31 Customer Insights Dashboard"
format: dashboard
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

case31 <- read_sav("Case 31 Data_efcu_1.sav")

overall_rating <- as_factor(case31$q37)
current_loan <- as_factor(case31$q27)

satisfaction_rate <- sum(
  overall_rating %in% c("Excellent", "Good")
) / sum(!is.na(overall_rating)) * 100

employee_score <- mean(
  case31$employeeperformance,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

loan_rate <- mean(
  current_loan == "Yes",
  na.rm = TRUE
) * 100
```

# Key Indicators

## Row

::: {.valuebox}
### Survey Responses

`r nrow(case31)`
:::

::: {.valuebox}
### Excellent or Good Rating

`r sprintf("%.1f%%", satisfaction_rate)`
:::

::: {.valuebox}
### Employee Performance (out of 5)

`r sprintf("%.2f", employee_score)`
:::

::: {.valuebox}
### Currently Have a Loan

`r sprintf("%.1f%%", loan_rate)`
:::

# Overall Rating

## Row

::: {.card}
### Overall Credit Union Rating

```{r}
rating_data <- case31 |>
  transmute(rating = as_factor(q37)) |>
  filter(!is.na(rating), rating != "No Opinion") |>
  count(rating)

ggplot(rating_data, aes(x = rating, y = n, fill = rating)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    title = "Overall Rating Distribution"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
:::

# Employee Service

## Row

::: {.card}
### Average Employee-Service Scores

```{r}
employee_items <- data.frame(
  measure = c(
    "Courteous",
    "Helpful",
    "Professional",
    "Available"
  ),
  score = c(
    mean(case31$q3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(case31$q4, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(case31$q5, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(case31$q6, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

ggplot(
  employee_items,
  aes(x = reorder(measure, score), y = score)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1f4e79") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average Score",
    title = "Employee-Service Ratings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
:::

# Interpretation

::: {.card}
### Key Findings

- Most respondents rated the credit union as either Excellent or Good.
- Employee courtesy received the strongest average score.
- Employee availability and professionalism received slightly lower scores.
- Fewer than half of respondents reported currently having a loan.
:::

::: {.card}
### Business Recommendations

- Maintain the strong employee courtesy and helpfulness performance.
- Investigate opportunities to improve employee availability.
- Promote relevant loan products to qualified members.
- Continue monitoring overall ratings and service-quality measures.
:::
